messages:
maya: starting zephyr customer LoRA onboarding — patched their adapter into redwood/zephyr-13b-4bit and ran the quick eval pack. seeing a KV cache shape mismatch at runtime and a perplexity/EM regression on docsqa. /cc @anand :eyes:

anand: can you paste the exact merge command + model config? also which quant backend (bitsandbytes / llmquant)?

maya: merge cmd i used:
```
python tools/merge_lora.py --base /models/zephyr-13b --lora /work/zephyr_lora_v1 --out /tmp/zephyr-merged --dtype=4bit --quant_backend=bitsandbytes
```
runtime error:
```
RuntimeError: KV cache shape mismatch (expected [8,128,4096] got [8,64,4096])
```

jess: ran quick-eval pack (smoketest-v2) on the merged artifact — sample 200 queries: exact_match down 6.2%, avg latency +12ms, some truncation hallucinations. sending top 3 failure examples inline.

jess: examples:
1) Q: "Summarize the release notes for X" -> expected: bullet summary; got truncated, missing key bullet points.
2) Q: "What is the API call for Y?" -> returned a partially-mangled signature
3) Q: "Step to reproduce Z" -> added extra unrelated steps (hallucination).

tom: KV shape mismatch usually means either seq_len mismatch or head-layout mismatch (num_kv_heads vs num_heads). zephyr base might be using 64 heads for kv or a different head-splitting. try remerging with head alignment or use adapter-stitcher flags: `--preserve-heads` or `--align-heads`. also confirm tokenizer.max_length and model.config['num_kv_heads'].

maya: ok will remerge with --align-heads. quick question: how do i run the quickpack deterministically? i used `./scripts/run_quickpack.sh merged` but results vary a bit.

anand: use deterministic seed: `QUICKPACK_SEED=42 ./scripts/run_quickpack.sh --artifact /tmp/zephyr-merged --pack smoketest-v2 --no-async`. upload logs to /mnt/zephyr-onboard/1918765432/ and include metrics json.

ci-bot: build finished for /tmp/zephyr-merged (sha: abc123) :white_check_mark:

maya: remerged with `--align-heads`, reran quickpack. perplexity improved (ppl -4%), EM delta now -2.1% (base 78.1 -> merged 76.0), avg_latency 120ms -> 132ms. attaching eval summary in the artifacts dir.

jess: next: run two ablations — (1) 8-bit quant baseline vs 4-bit merged, (2) run eval with kv_cache disabled to check whether prefix caching is affecting outputs. that'll tell if quant or kv layout induced the regression.

maya: launching both ablations now, will post results in ~30m. thanks! :thumbsup:

anand: if regression persists after ablations, propose a split-rollout plan: route 10% traffic to merged via canary, attach regression triggers (eval on synthetic prompts + user-critical prompt set) and automatic rollback. we'll only advance if metrics stable.

maya: noted. will open rollout PR if needed and include canary config + rollback thresholds.
